svg.title: \begin{split} L_U&=\lceil\log_2(U+4)\rceil,\qquad r_U=\lceil L_U^{1/5}\rceil,\\ K&=\max\left\{1, \left\lfloor\frac{\lfloor U^{2/15}\rfloor}{r_U^2} \right\rfloor\right\},\\ h_k&=\lceil U^{14/15}\rceil r_U,\qquad k=2^{h_k},\\ h_C&=c_C\left(\left\lceil\frac UK\right\rceil +\lceil U^{2/3}\rceil L_U+L_U\right),\qquad C_p=2^{h_C},\\ \gamma_*&=2^{c_C\lceil U^{2/3}\rceil L_U},\qquad P_*=C_p^{16},\\ H_p&=2^{\lceil\log_2(4(h_C+1))\rceil},\\ d_*&=\left\lceil\frac{8U}{h_k}\right\rceil+10,\qquad b_*=(c_0+100)U(d_*+1). \end{split} \tag{2}
